title: Indicate which tasks belong to which desktops when sorting by desktop
line: When the task manager shows windows from all desktops sorted by desktop, a small gap with a separator line now marks where each desktop's windows begin.
explanation: With "Sort: By desktop" and "Show only tasks from the current desktop" off, the task manager ordered tasks by desktop but drew them as one continuous row, so there was no way to tell at a glance which windows were on which desktop. The only hint was the desktop name in each tooltip. Each task now works out the desktop it is sorted under ("all desktops" counts as its own group) and, when it differs from the previous task's, adds a Kirigami largeSpacing gap before itself with a theme separator line (widgets/line) in the middle.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: separate desktops when sorting tasks by desktop

When tasks from all desktops were shown sorted by desktop, nothing showed
where one desktop's tasks ended and the next began. Now a small gap with
a separator line is added between tasks that belong to different desktops.

BUG: 410453

media.caption: Icons-only task manager, sorted by desktop, windows from 3 desktops: one continuous row (Konsole, XTerm | Dolphin, Konsole, XTerm | Dolphin, XTerm)
Same windows: a gap with a separator line between the desktop 1, 2 and 3 groups
Live update after setting one XTerm to all desktops and moving another to desktop 1: groups are all desktops | 1 | 2 | 3
Vertical panel, normal (left) and reversed bottom-to-top (right): separators land between the right groups
